svg.aria-label: A paper-cream page in ink. A wide faint rectangle holds sixteen small open circles in two rows; eight of them, scattered through both rows, are filled solid, and one of the eight is filled in warm kiln-orange. Below the rectangle stand nine thin uprights of unequal height, rising from one baseline, with a faint horizontal rule drawn across them at the height of the shortest. The last upright is drawn in warm kiln-orange and stands third-tallest of the nine.
svg.title: The Still · Thailand, PISA 2025 · eight inside sixteen, and nine rounds
svg.desc: A composition for Edition 06's third piece. Paper-cream ground, pure line, no fills except the circles the composition is about, tone carried by stroke opacity alone. The faint rectangle is the OECD's since-2022 list and the sixteen circles are its sixteen systems. The eight filled circles are the eight that Thailand's national PISA centre reports rose in all three subjects on the same clock — a strict subset, which is why they sit inside the same rectangle rather than beside it. The orange one is Thailand. The nine uprights below are Thailand's nine science averages from PISA 2000 to PISA 2025, to the scale the institute's own series gives; the faint horizontal rule is drawn at the height of the shortest, which is 2022, the round the last upright is measured from. The last upright is orange and is the third-tallest of the nine, not the tallest: 2012 and 2000 stand above it. The gap between the band and the uprights is left empty because the list and the series are two different measurements of one country.
